# neo4jaura Provider

Neo4j Aura Terraform Provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "neo4jaura" {
  client_id     = var.client_id
  client_secret = var.client_secret
}

variable "client_id" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "client_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `client_id` (String, Sensitive) Aura Client ID. Can also be set via the `AURA_CLIENT_ID` environment variable.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Aura Client Secret. Can also be set via the `AURA_CLIENT_SECRET` environment variable.
- `instance_timeout` (Number) Timeout for instance operations (seconds). Defaults to `1200` seconds.
- `snapshot_timeout` (Number) Timeout for snapshot operations (seconds). Defaults to `300` seconds.
